violated_contract: An existing complete derived record must not suppress useful late source revisions indefinitely. Date-only idempotency returned daily recaps before reading conversation inputs, and the backfill inherited the same blind guard.
canonical_prevention: Compare meaningful source membership and content revisions before reusing a derived record. Adopt legacy inputs without blessing stale content, retain durable repair and verification obligations across racing writes, and bound regeneration with transactional owner-wide counters. Patch generated content without replacing independently owned privacy or delivery state.
